title: Ring colimit and sections comparison for one affine chart
statement: Under the scheme and base-change conventions of def-pc-scheme and def-pc-base-change, let I be a directed preorder, R its ring diagram and c an affine limiting spectrum cone. Fix i, a map Xi to Spec(R_i), an affine member of an open cover of Xi, and any module M on the ambient limit base change. Write Z for the fixed limit chart and N for the sections of the restriction of M to Z. There is a diagram F on the upper tail above i with colimit isomorphic to Gamma(Z), and for each stage j there are ring isomorphisms F(j) to the stage chart ring and Gamma(Z) to the iterated limit chart ring. The latter identifies the canonical colimit map with the chart pullback map after the stage comparison; extending N along it gives the sections of the restriction of M to the iterated chart. No finite-presentation assumption or stage model of N is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01ZR first proof, affine case; schemes.tex Tag 01I6; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01I6

proof.text: Obtain the ring-colimit presentation and geometric chart isomorphisms from exists_affine_chart_ring_colimit_geometric. Apply contravariant global sections to each geometric chart isomorphism h to get the ring isomorphism s. Its compatibility with the ambient chart maps lets nonempty_module_sections_pullback_iso_transport identify the two restriction-section modules after scalar extension. Assemble the existential witnesses and both equations. The ring-colimit helper itself applies Mathlib preservation of affine limits by global sections to the upper-tail geometric limit; its ring-map equation is contravariant functoriality of appTop.

theorem exists_affine_chart_sections_colimit_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (V : Xi.OpenCover.{u}) (a : V.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (V.X a)) :
    let W := V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (c.π.app (op i)))
    let Z := W.X a
    let N := ModuleCat.of Γ(Z, ⊤) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W.f a)).obj M, ⊤)
    ∃ F : {j : I // i ≤ j} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u},
      ∃ q : colimit F ≅ Γ(Z, ⊤),
      ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
        let U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property)))).OpenCover.{u} :=
          V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))
        let p := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j.val)) (c.w (homOfLE j.property).op))
        let Y := (U.pullback₁ p).X a
        let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ p).f a)).obj M
        ∃ (e : F.obj j ≅ Γ(U.X a, ⊤)) (s : Γ(Z, ⊤) ≅ Γ(Y, ⊤)),
          colimit.ι F j ≫ q.hom ≫ s.hom = e.hom ≫ (U.pullbackHom p a).appTop ∧
          Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars s.hom.hom).obj N ≅
            ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(P, ⊤))
